title: Very poor quality !!!
text:
Very poor quality !!!. To say that these bathroom rugs are of a poor quality is an understatement !! I have purchased plenty of bathroom rugs over the years in brick/mortar stores. NEVER would these Garland rugs have been selected if I'd felt them.

They have almost miniscule "thickness". They are similar to that cheap indoor/outdoor carpet with a bit of fuzziness to give the illusion of plush. On the bright side, the backing is nice, lol. It's not worth it (to me) to send them back, so I will donate them to an animal rescue for cage liners.

As for "seafoam" color, it is very vivid.

product_metadata.title: Garland Rug Traditional Bath Rug, 2-Piece Set, Seafoam
features: Set Includes: 17 in. x 24 in. Mat and a 21 in. x 34 in. Mat
description: Traditional bath rugs by Garland Rug are soft and stylish. The plush design lends a classic understated touch to your bath coordinates collection. This 2-piece rug set comes with both a 17 inch. x 24 inch. Bath mat and a 21 inch. x 34 inch. bath mat. The soft pile of this rug is made of 100% Nylon and features a washable skid resistant latex backing. Like all products made by Garland Rug these Traditional rugs are proudly made in the USA.
